projects.name: LKPM Monitor
projects.short_id: Sistem monitoring laporan investasi (LKPM Non-UMK) untuk DPMPTSP dengan skor prioritas perusahaan dan tindak lanjut PIC.
projects.short_en: Investment report (LKPM Non-UMK) monitoring system for a government agency with company priority scoring and PIC follow-up.

features.id: Impor 4 file Excel OSS dengan deduplikasi & aturan validasi
features.en: Import of 4 OSS Excel files with deduplication & validation rules

features.id: Mesin skor prioritas 100 perusahaan (bobot dapat diatur)
features.en: Priority scoring engine for 100 companies (configurable weights)

features.id: Dashboard capaian per triwulan & perbandingan YoY
Modul follow-up PIC dengan log kontak perusahaan
features.en: PIC follow-up module with company contact logs

body.id: Dirancang aturan dedup berlapis (kunci logis + tanggal lapor terbaru + status) agar satu laporan tidak terhitung dua kali.
body.en: Designed layered dedup rules (logical key + latest report date + status) so one report is never double-counted.

body.id: Antarmuka disederhanakan: kartu info anti salah-info dan alur impor terpandu langkah demi langkah.
body.en: Simplified UI: mistake-proof info cards and a guided step-by-step import flow.

projects.name: Rumah Cahaya-bks
projects.short_id: Marketplace Ebook anak & MiniApp HTML5 (PWA) dengan checkout QRIS dan verifikasi admin.
projects.short_en: Children's Ebook & HTML5 MiniApp marketplace (PWA) with QRIS checkout and admin verification.

features.id: Katalog produk & bundle dengan halaman promo / iklan
features.en: Product & bundle catalog with promo / ad landing pages

features.id: MiniApp terpasang sebagai PWA per produk (install token)
Panel admin lengkap: order, backup, log aktivitas
features.en: Full admin panel: orders, backups, activity logs

title.id: PWA di iOS tanpa login ulang

body.id: Entitlement memakai install token per perangkat agar MiniApp tetap bisa dibuka dari Home Screen iOS.
body.en: Entitlement via per-device install tokens so MiniApps open straight from the iOS Home Screen.

projects.name: OSS Data Scraper
projects.short_id: Alat otomasi penarikan data OSS: login, OTP, pencarian NIB, dan ekspor laporan.
projects.short_en: OSS data extraction automation: login, OTP, NIB search, and report export.

features.id: Ekspor hasil ke Excel siap olah

body.id: Selector dibuat tangguh dengan fallback berlapis dan retry cerdas.
body.en: Resilient selectors with layered fallbacks and smart retries.

journey.body_id: Membangun ulang sistem monitoring LKPM Non-UMK: impor data OSS, skor prioritas perusahaan, dan tindak lanjut PIC.
journey.body_en: Rebuilding the Non-UMK LKPM monitoring system: OSS data imports, company priority scoring, and PIC follow-ups.

journey.body_id: Marketplace Ebook anak & MiniApp PWA: 6 fase selesai, live di rumahcahaya.web.id.
journey.body_en: Children's Ebook & MiniApp PWA marketplace: 6 phases done, live at rumahcahaya.web.id.

journey.body_id: Fokus Laravel + JavaScript modern; proyek otomasi data dan aplikasi web dinas.
journey.body_en: Focus on Laravel + modern JavaScript; data automation tools and agency web apps.
